title: contract report
description: What check contract finds, from check contract -o json: where a block that holds state and the flows disagree on the fields it writes. A finding never fails the check, since either side may be the wrong one.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always ContractReport, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: The findings, worst first, with the counts and the flows read.

findings.description: One per disagreement: unknown first, then undeclared, unexercised and misplaced, each by block.

rule.description: What disagrees, an open word a reader decides by. Known words: unknown: a flow writes into an id no block carries; undeclared: a flow writes a field the block does not list in writes; unexercised: the block lists a field no step writes; misplaced: a flow writes into a block whose kind holds no state.

block.description: The block it is about, or the id no block carries.

title.description: The block's title; (no block) for unknown.

flows.description: The flows whose steps write those fields, sorted; empty for unexercised.

message.description: The same for people; programs never decide by it.

counts.description: How many blocks could be checked, declared and unstated, and how many findings of each rule word; an open map, as rule is an open word. declared: blocks that hold state and list the fields they write, the only ones that can be checked; unstated: blocks that hold state and list nothing yet, not a finding.

propertyNames.description: declared, unstated, or a rule word.

flows.description: The ids of the flows read.
